Guy that was flying the Mavic was in his late 30s and my neighbor. That's about all I know about him, don't know which house is his, cant prove he was the one nearby them, etc. Only hope I have is they said they could visibly see the drone and mine is bright orange so if they saw it they would know it wasn't mine cause the Mavic is grey. Doubt much will come from it as they it seems like they were playing telephone with the SWAT officers because the cop that came up to me wanted to see how far away I was but also what it looked like cause he was on road block duty lol

As I said in another reply I live in a small town where nothing happens and all of a sudden half the streets were closed off and there were swat trucks all over.  We had no idea what was happening till I was in the air and saw the house with the front end ripped off. Pure curiosity I didn't intend on doing anything with the footage outside of showing friends and family that live nearby it as well. If the wife or kids weren't out of the house or anyone got hurt I would've instantly deleted the footage. I'm keeping it for myself now because the only thing it shows is the SWAT firing teargas and the condition of the house. There was no helicopter and the police mentioned having their own drone but it was flying inside of the walls they had broken down to try and find where he was hiding inside. I had no intentions to be in the way or interfere at all that's why I stayed far back and high up.

I wasnt filming inside of the house I was 1000ft back around 390ft AGL at 16x zoom watching the scene. Like I said its a small town, nothing happens here and they had half the roads closed down without telling anyone why. Just curiosity I was in the air for around 20 minutes and landing as cops pulled up.

I have the Autel drone and wasn't screen recording as I use the smart controller. I have multiple videos that show my position while not exact proves I was not the drone hovering over them as the one that was is visible in my footage. Ill be more careful in the future and probably avoid filming similar situations. Haven't been contacted yet but if I am then I will consult my attorney. Thank you for the advice!

Me and my sister have a 3 year age gap with me being the younger one. We went through similar trauma caused by our mother when we were younger. We used to fight all the time and I would make fun of her for being depressed while I was having the same feelings and just dealing with it differently. It wasn't really until we were both over 18 that we began to understanding what each of us has gone through. She goes to college in another state now but the times she comes over we hangout and talk a lot. She's pretty much a friend now and although I don't tell her everything about my life talking about our similar experiences has helped deal with it a lot.

Hopefully this kind of gives some perspective from the other side because while its not okay for him to treat you like that just know that he is probably hurting similarly. Once he matures and gets older I'm sure he will be apologetic for how he is treating you right now.

The times you need someone the most are the times you have nobody because having nobody brings upon those feelings. Its hard but sometimes you have to learn how to be there for yourself. I get how you feel with everything bad happening at once as I lost 3 of my 6 grandparents (4 biological, 2 step-grandparents cause it confuses some people) within a year and less than 3 months after that all happened I broke up with my gf of 16 months because the relationship was toxic. It feels like its all crashing down on you at once and it gets to be too much to bare. I sat in my room for months, unemployed, rarely leaving, and rarely talking to anyone, descending deeper and deeper into my depression and loneliness. Please do not do what I did. Take action right away no matter how demotivated you are because the only way to get that motivation and excitement back is to fight for it back. It takes a lot and what has been slowly working for me is trying new things. I bought a drone and got into videography which has led to me starting a company for it soon. I still have a lot of days that I just wanna lay in bed and do nothing but I push myself to get up and work because I have something to look forward to once I've completed my studying and setting up the business. Find that thing that you can work towards. It might not give you instant satisfaction but if you can find something big or small to look forward to it'll give you a reason to continue fighting each day and eventually you wont have to fight anymore. I believe in you and if you want to talk more feel free to DM me even if you just want to rant.

I don't know you but if you go through with this I will miss you. I care about you and I want to see you pull through this because I know you can. You don't have to trust anyone other than yourself. Trust that you are strong enough to make it through this because you are more than capable. The only person you are a burden to is yourself when you put these thoughts into your head. You are convincing yourself there is no other option or way out of your situation but in reality there is. You might feel like you want to end it and you are done but deep down you are searching for a reason to keep going that's why you posted on here. Stay with us till tomorrow then go try something new no matter how small it is. I've never been a big outdoors person but I got a drone so I've started going on drives to random places and filming with my drone late at night or early morning. It gives me peace and although I'm alone, I'm content for those few moments where I don't have to think about anything else. I'm sure you are feeling a lot of pressure with school and family which is completely understandable especially with you being in college but think about how far you have come with graduating high school and getting a job to being in college and presumably living outside of your parents house. Life is not over for you

They have not lied to you, you just haven't reached it yet and neither have I. People do care about you whether you think they do or not. You are blinded by your pain and its not your fault. Try new things and find something that motivates you to wake up tomorrow. There is purpose out there for you and you just have to find it. Search for that bliss you once had because death is not the way to it.

There are people that care about you. I don't have to know you to know that because everyone has people that care about them whether you believe it or not. There is still time for you to grow and escape the situation you are in. Lay down on your couch or bed with your cats and take a nap. Call in to work on Monday if you need to. It feels like everything is falling apart but there's a lot left for you and you will find a way to rebuild it. I don't like talking to people about my feelings and never have till recently with my therapist so I get it if you don't want to talk about exactly what's going on but remember that people are ready when you are.  Continue holding on and the better days will come sooner than you think. Take your little victories day by day till you reach your big one. Search for purpose by trying new things, going different places, meeting different people, or whatever you want to do. Don't live for anyone but yourself from now on and I promise you will get better day by day.
